hints.title: Divisor Residue Palindromes
hints.text: A string of length L is a semi-palindrome if there exists a proper divisor d of L such that indices i = rem mod d form palindromes for all 0 <= rem < d.

hints.title: Precomputing Substring Costs
hints.text: For every substring s[i..j], compute the minimum character replacements needed to make it a semi-palindrome across all valid divisors d of its length.

hints.title: Partitioning Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Let dp[cnt][j] be the minimum changes to partition s[0..j] into cnt semi-palindromes. Transition by taking min over i of dp[cnt - 1][i - 1] + cost[i][j].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputing divisor semi-palindrome costs followed by 2D DP.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive partition without precomputation is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) cost table for all substrings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precompute divisor palindromic costs and partition using 2D DP.
